text:
marta: Hey folks, I pushed a new iteration of the Credentials page. Main goals: clarify the difference between rotate vs revoke, make bulk actions safer, and fix keyboard/tab flow in the modals. Figma: https://figma.com/snap/abc-credentials. Would love quick reactions on copy and the proposed safety nets. colin: Nice visual cleanup. Two high-level asks: 1) show potential impact before destructive actions (even a rough count), 2) avoid alarmist language for rotate. Rotate is usually the preferred flow for compromised keys because it's less disruptive. sam: A11y notes: modal focus should land on the primary descriptive text, not the CTA. Users should be able to cancel with Esc and have focus return to the originating control. For bulk flows, keyboard nav between selected items is painful right now. anika: Proposed safety nets: for single revoke, show a short confirmation modal with an "Estimated impact: ~3 services" line (we can compute via last-used routes heuristic). For bulk revoke, require a typed confirmation like the key name for >10 items. Also proposing a 2-minute "grace window" toast where revoke is queued and an Undo is available. Thoughts? marta: I like the queued/revoke grace idea — softer than instant destructive actions, helpful for ops mistakes. But we need to be explicit about what queued means. Copy suggestion: "Revoke scheduled. Integrations will stop within 2 minutes unless you undo." colin: Copy tweak: instead of "Integrations will stop" use "Requests using this key will fail" — slightly more precise. Also add a small line listing where the key is referenced (most recent routes/apps) so people can quickly assess. sam: Implementation/aria snippet for the queued toast (screenreader friendly): ```html
Revocation scheduled for API key \"payments-proxy\".
``` Make sure the Undo button receives focus programmatically after the toast appears when triggered via keyboard. anika: On rotate copy, propose milder tone: header "Rotate key to generate replacement" body "Rotation creates a new key and keeps the old one active for 2 minutes to allow cutover." CTA "Rotate and copy" secondary "Cancel" marta: UX nit: the permission badges in the list are visually heavy and push metadata down. Suggest a collapsed summary line like "Perms: billing, logs +2" that expands on hover/focus. That keeps rows compact and improves scan. colin: One more: when a revoked key is deleted from the list, we should move focus to the table header filter so keyboard users can continue managing keys without losing context. If there's a toast with Undo, move focus there first. sam: Accessibility test cases we should add: screenreader announces toast, focus returned correctly after Undo, tab order in modal is logical (cancel before destructive in DOM for muscle memory), and bulk-confirm modal requires typing only when count exceeds threshold. anika: Action items: I'll update the Figma with: - queued revoke flow copy and toast behavior - rotate phrasing with 2-minute overlap - collapsed permission chips - keyboard focus fixes in modal DOM order. I'll also add notes for engineering around estimated-impact heuristic and bulk thresholds. Will post a screenshot in ~45m. ux-bot: Design review logged: reviewer: colin, sam. Priority: medium. Deliverable: updated mockups and a11y checklist.
